title: Global Trends and Heterogeneity in Modified Adjusted Net Savings
abstract: arXiv:2611.12987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modified adjusted net savings is a derived weak sustainability indicator obtained by subtracting education expenditure from adjusted net savings (ANS). Because ANS equals net national savings plus education expenditure minus natural-resource depletion and carbon dioxide damage, MANS isolates the savings and depletion components and is useful when education expenditure would otherwise dominate cross-country comparisons. This study documents the global distribution, long-run trends, and cross-country heterogeneity of MANS excluding particulate emission damage over 1990-2021. The accounting base is the World Bank World Development Indicators series NY.ADJ.SVNX.CD, and MANS is constructed by subtracting education expenditure from this series. We combine global maps, aggregate time series, country-level heatmaps, distributional statistics, and income group comparisons. The results show that global MANS has increased substantially in aggregate

translated_title: 修正调整净储蓄的全球趋势与异质性
translated_abstract: 修正调整净储蓄（MANS）是通过从调整净储蓄（ANS）中减去教育支出而派生出的一种弱可持续性指标。由于ANS等于国民净储蓄加上教育支出再减去自然资源消耗和二氧化碳损害，MANS将储蓄与资源消耗部分单独分离出来，在教育支出会主导跨国比较结果的情况下尤为有用。本研究记录了1990-2021年间剔除颗粒物排放损害的MANS的全球分布、长期趋势和跨国异质性。其核算基础为世界银行世界发展指标数据库中的NY.ADJ.SVNX.CD序列，MANS通过从该序列中减去教育支出而构建。研究综合运用了全球地图、总体时间序列、国家层面热力图、分布统计以及收入组别比较等方法。结果表明，全球MANS在总体上呈现大幅增长。
tldr: 本研究基于世界银行数据构建了剔除教育支出的修正调整净储蓄（MANS）指标，系统刻画了1990-2021年间全球弱可持续性的分布格局、长期趋势与跨国异质性，发现全球MANS总体呈显著上升趋势。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a Modified Adjusted Net Savings (MANS) indicator by subtracting education expenditure from World Bank ANS data, documenting the global distribution, long-run trends, and cross-country heterogeneity of weak sustainability from 1990 to 2021, and finding that global MANS has increased substantially in aggregate.
